summary: Implemented the window title feature; nothing committed and no tests or code run, per instructions. Changes: rich/segment.py adds SET_WINDOW_TITLE = 16 and extends the ControlCode union with Tuple[ControlType, str]. rich/control.py adds the format entry "\x1b]0;{title}\x07" and Control.title(title). rich/console.py adds set_window_title(title) beside show_cursor; it buffers the control only when is_terminal and returns True or False. rich/_windows_renderer.py adds one branch that calls term.set_title(title) with the code's second item. CHANGELOG.md has an Unreleased Added bullet linking pull request 2200. Tests added: test_console.py::test_set_window_title (skipped on win32), test_control.py::test_control_title, and test_windows_renderer.py::test_control_set_window_title (Windows only). Black formatting and test results are unverified because nothing was run.
